name: Pomme de Terre River — Hermitage Access to Cross Timbers Access
gaugeName: Pomme de Terre River at Hermitage, MO (USGS 06921500)
blurb: Pomme de Terre River in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Hermitage Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Cross Timbers Access: exact agency access pin. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

putInAccess.sourceName: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 121
putInAccess.note: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 121 (Boat ramp (MDC)) is the managing agency's own access feature, 48 m from the USGS NHD High Resolution flowline of the Pomme de Terre River. Imagery check 2026-10-30: Pin on the bank at a visible ramp, gravel landing, bridge access or bank access. Public access: Missouri Department of Conservation — Hermitage Access (area page).
